_comment: Labelled retrieval-eval set. Each query names the document(s) whose source_ref must appear in the top-k. Relevance is judged at document level (a chunk hit counts if its parent document's source_ref is expected). OWASP + attack-surface refs are deterministic; NVD is ingested for coverage but not judged here because its returned CVE ids are not pinnable. evaluate.py compares hybrid vs dense-only vs lexical-only against this set.
